title: The Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032
publisher: Ministry of ICT, Innovation and Youth Affairs
why_not: States backbone and area coverage only: NOFBI Phase 2 fibre and metro networks to all 47 county headquarters from 2014 and 510 km of last mile in county headquarters, with 1650 public institutions connected in all; no count or statement of county government offices connected, and its plan falls outside the governance window.
